consumerClasses.reason: Card's header and footer and InputGroup's addons pad only when a consumer passes Tailwind's border-b or border-t, which no element carries here.

coverageExclusions.attachment: AttachmentTrigger's type default when given a render element is a branch the docs example never takes.
coverageExclusions.calendar: CalendarDayButton's focus effect and the dropdown caption run only on interaction or with captionLayout set at runtime.
coverageExclusions.carousel: Carousel's scroll state, button handlers, keyboard navigation and API callbacks run only once Embla measures slides and the user scrolls.
coverageExclusions.chart: ChartTooltipContent, ChartLegendContent and their payload formatting render only inside a sized Recharts chart, which jsdom cannot give (about half the file).
coverageExclusions.drawer: DrawerContent marks snap points only when given snapPoints, which the docs example never passes as a literal.
coverageExclusions.field: FieldError's errors-list handling (none, one, or several deduplicated) and the orientation and alert paths the docs example never renders.
coverageExclusions.input-group: InputGroupAddon's click-to-focus handler and the addon and button alignments the docs example never renders.
coverageExclusions.input-otp: InputOTPSlot's fake caret shows only while the input has focus, and its fallback for a missing OTPInput context only outside InputOTP; the docs example renders neither.
coverageExclusions.sidebar: Sidebar's toggle, keyboard shortcut, cookie write, rail and mobile sheet run only on interaction or a mobile viewport.
coverageExclusions.slider: Slider's branch for a controlled value needs a literal value, which the docs example never passes.
coverageExclusions.toast: The toast list, per-type icons and the default manager render only for toasts added at runtime through the manager (about half the file).
coverageExclusions.use-mobile: useIsMobile's change handler runs only when the viewport crosses the breakpoint.
